{'text': 'Earlier this month, Google launched the all-new Pixel 11 series. Compared to the previous-generation Pixel 10, the overall changes on the new device are not that significant, but it includes some delightful user experience optimisations. One of these is a brand-new camera processing option, allowing you to have finer control over the final result of an entire photo.', 'note': '', 'translation': '本月早些時候，Google 推出了全新的 Pixel 11 系列。相比上一代 Pixel 10，新機整體改動不算太大，但加入了一些令人欣喜的使用體驗優化。其中一項是全新的相機處理選項，讓你可以更仔細地掌控整張相片的最終效果。'}

{'text': "With the iPhone 18 Pro launch on the horizon, I'm expecting Apple to roll out something similar.", 'note': '', 'translation': '在 iPhone 18 Pro 推出前夕，我期望 Apple 也會推出類似的功能。'}

{'text': "The Pixel 11 introduces a new camera feature called Camera Looks, which is in some ways similar to iPhone's Photographic Styles, allowing you to adjust how the camera processes what it captures. These adjustments are applied before you take the shot – it's not just a filter slapped on top.", 'note': '', 'translation': 'Pixel 11 加入了一項名為 Camera Looks 的新相機功能，某程度上與 iPhone 的 Photographic Styles 相似，可以調校相機拍攝時的處理方式。這些調整在拍攝之前已經進行，不只是一層濾鏡那麼簡單。'}

{'text': "Google offers a number of preset styles, similar to what Apple does, and you can also fine-tune each preset's effect. Beyond those familiar options, there are a few styles that tap into a new trend in mobile photography: Editorial, Velvet, Classic, Digi, Black Tie, and Minimal.", 'note': '', 'translation': 'Google 提供了不少預設風格，類似 Apple 的做法，而且還可以細緻調校每個預設的效果。除了這些常見選項之外，還有幾個捕捉到流動攝影新趨勢的風格：Editorial、Velvet、Classic、Digi、Black Tie 和 Minimal。'}

{'text': 'These styles are all deliberately avoiding the over-processed look of current smartphone photos, attempting to recapture the feel of old-school photography. As the name suggests, Digi aims to deliver the low dynamic range, high contrast, and noisy look of those tiny pocket cameras from the 2010s.', 'note': '', 'translation': '這些風格都刻意避開現時智能手機相片過度運算的觀感，嘗試重現舊式相片的味道。顧名思義，Digi 就是要呈現 2010 年代那些細細部、袋裝相機才有的低動態範圍、高對比和充滿雜訊的效果。'}

{'text': "Minimal, on the other hand, goes in the opposite direction, minimising computational processing. Many HDR pipelines won't kick in, letting you see what the smartphone sensor actually captures. You can head over to 9to5Google to check out the sample photos.", 'note': '', 'translation': '至於 Minimal，則走向另一個極端，盡量減少運算處理。很多 HDR 管道都不會啟動，讓你看到智能手機感光元件真正捕捉到的影像。可以到 9to5Google 看看相關的樣本相片。'}

{'text': "Using iPhone's ProRAW format, in theory, allows you to bring a photo back to a state that doesn't look too post-processed, but doing so somewhat defeats the point of shooting on a phone.", 'note': '', 'translation': '用 iPhone 的 ProRAW 格式，理論上可以將相片還原至一個不會顯得太過後製的狀態，但這樣做某程度上已經失去了用手機影相的意義。'}

{'text': 'Wrap-up', 'note': '', 'translation': '總結'}

{'text': "If Apple wants to be the best camera in everyone's pocket, it needs to recognise that not every user wants the same look. Photographic Styles is a good start, but Apple should go further. At the end of the day, photography is an art of self-expression, so giving users more options to control the computational processing of their photos is the right direction. Apple should borrow from Google and add a 'Minimal' style to iPhone.", 'note': '', 'translation': '如果 Apple 想成為大家口袋裡最好的相機，就要明白不是每個用戶都想要同一種效果。Photographic Styles 是一個好的起步，但 Apple 應該走得更遠。說到底，攝影是一種自我表達的藝術，所以給用戶多一點選項去控制相片的運算程度，才是正確的方向。Apple 應該借鏡 Google，在 iPhone 加入「Minimal」風格。'}

{'text': "What are your thoughts on the current state of iPhone photography? Do you like Apple's recent Photographic Styles changes, or do you think there's still room for improvement? Drop a comment and share your take.", 'note': '', 'translation': '你對 iPhone 攝影的現狀有什麼看法？你喜不喜歡 Apple 近期的 Photographic Styles 改動，還是覺得仍有改進空間？歡迎留言分享你的意見。'}

{'text': 'My top Apple accessory recommendations:', 'note': '', 'translation': '我最推薦的 Apple 配件：'}

  • {'text': 'Anker Ultra-Slim MagSafe Charger power bank', 'note': '', 'translation': 'Anker Ultra-Slim MagSafe 充電器流動電源'}
  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3 (active noise cancellation is twice as effective as AirPods Pro 2!)', 'note': '', 'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3（主動降噪效能比 AirPods Pro 2 提升兩倍！）'}
  • {'text': 'Anker Nano 45W fast charger with smart display', 'note': '', 'translation': 'Anker Nano 45W 快速充電器配智能顯示屏'}
  • {'text': 'Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W slim MagSafe charger', 'note': '', 'translation': 'Anker Prime 3 合 1 25W 纖薄 MagSafe 充電器'}
  • {'text': 'Logitech MX Master 4 for Mac mouse', 'note': '', 'translation': 'Logitech MX Master 4 Mac 版滑鼠'}
  • {'text': 'AirTag 2 4-pack (Precision Finding improved by 50%)', 'note': '', 'translation': 'AirTag 2 四件裝（精確尋找功能提升 50%）'}

{'text': 'Follow Michael: X/Twitter, Bluesky, Instagram', 'note': '', 'translation': '追蹤 Michael：X/Twitter、Bluesky、Instagram'}
